def one(text, old, new):
    if text.count(old) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError('unexpected occurrence: ' + repr(old[:80]))
    return text.replace(old, new, 1)


def one_of(text, alternatives, new):
    present = [old for old in alternatives if text.count(old)]
    if len(present) != 1 or text.count(present[0]) != 1:
        raise RuntimeError('missing or ambiguous formatting-compatible anchor')
    return text.replace(present[0], new, 1)
